Hearing voices that tell you to do things you don't want to do sounds frightening, and I'm glad you're reaching out. Please take this seriously and seek help right away. If you feel like you might act on what the voices are saying or if you're in any danger, please call emergency services (911) or go to your nearest emergency room immediately.

You can also reach out to a crisis line like the National Suicide Prevention Lifeline at 988 or text HOME to 741741 to connect with someone who can support you right now. Please also contact a healthcare provider or mental health professional as soon as possible — they can help you understand what's happening and find treatment that can help. You don't have to manage this alone, and there are people who want to help you feel safe.
